Compare reads two runs' results.jsonl and, for each set and system both
hold, prints each run's hit@1, @5 and @10, MRR@10, nDCG@10 and median times
over the queries both answered, then first minus second for recall@5 and
MRR@10 with a 95% interval (a bootstrap by question, or by session for
episodes, as cmp.py drew it), how many queries flip in or out of the top 5,
and how many top 10s differ.

Usage:
  agent index eval compare RUN_A RUN_B [flags]

Examples:
  agent index eval compare runs/A runs/B
  agent index eval compare runs/A runs/B --set blind3 --system base:index@scope

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for compare
      --resamples int   Bootstrap resamples (default 10000)
      --seed int        Bootstrap seed (default 20261123)
      --set string      Only this set
      --system string   Only this system

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
